name: Liber Auxilia
source: Liber Auxilia, English edition 2025 (photographed pages) — pages are PDF page numbers; Tercio Transport slots read as Heavy Transport from the icons, to be checked

detachments.name: Veletaris Tercio
detachments.note: Gain the Veletaris Tercio Trait. Elites: Veletaris Storm or Vanguard Sections; Support: Hermes Veletaris Squadrons.

detachments.name: Infantry Tercio
detachments.note: Gain the Infantry Tercio Trait. Troops: Lasrifle Sections; Recon: Hermes Light Sentinel Squadrons.

detachments.name: Artillery Tercio
detachments.note: Gain the Artillery Tercio Trait. Support: Rapier Sections, Basilisks, Medusas.

detachments.name: Armour Tercio
detachments.note: Gain the Armour Tercio Trait. Armour: Leman Russ Strike / Assault, Malcador.

detachments.name: Scout Tercio
detachments.note: Gain the Scout Tercio Trait. Recon: Hermes Light Sentinels; War Engine: Aethon Heavy Sentinels.

detachments.name: Iron Tercio
detachments.note: Iron Pattern Cohort only. Units from Liber Mechanicum, which gain the Iron Tercio Faction Trait.
